author: reek
body: A cubemap skybox, sampled per pixel from Codex [Device] AST. Each pixel's camera ray direction (panning with the frame) samples a procedural environment: a sky gradient, a warm sun with a glow, banded clouds, and a dark ground below the horizon. Reference site's "texture cubemap" technique (a procedural cube instead of six loaded faces). Float math from DeviceMath.

author: reek
body: Clouds live on a horizontal plane above the camera: a ray going up (dy > 0) hits the plane at distance 1.3 / dy, and the plane coordinate there indexes the cloud noise -- so the clouds recede to the horizon in proper perspective and read as an overhead cloud layer rather than screen-space swirls.
